services.name: 22’ Center Console Rental 3
services.desc: See Charleston the way it was meant to be seen - by water. Our 22' Sea Fox Center Console Boat has 200 HP and is the perfect boat to cruise Shem Creek down to the Charleston Harbor. While in the harbor, you can cruise by the USS Yorktown, the Charleston Battery, Fort Sumter, Fort Moultrie and Castle Pickney. Rentals are 2 hours, 4 hours or 8 hours and a $500 credit card security deposit is required before you can take the boat out. Fuel is included in the rental price. You must be at least 21 years old to rent one of our boats and have a valid driver's license or passport. You must carry a cell phone on your person while on the boat so we can contact you if needed. Maximum number of people

services.name: 4 Hour Inshore Fishing Charter
services.desc: Make your trip to Charleston memorable with one of our inshore fishing charters. The inlets, sounds, bays, tidal creeks, marsh grass and oyster banks in our area make Charleston one of the top inshore fishing destinations on the East Coast. With over slot redfish tailing in the grass to doormat flounder being pulled from the muddy bottom, our inshore charter is sure to inspire you to come back to our beautiful estuaries. Flounder, speckled sea trout, lady fish, or black drum are also popular amongst inshore anglers. Seasickness, big waves and wind are minimal for inshore charters, so these trips are perfect for families who do not want to deal with the harsh elements the sea can offer.
